reviews.review_title: Review at Hem Quan - 96 Chua Ha
reviews.review_text:
Sandra Tang
Hanoi, Vietnam7 contributions
0
Nice Ambience, Airy and Homely feeling Place with Nice Food
Nov 2018 • Family
Came across the restaurant on a platform (Foody) that widely use in Vietnam to search for nice places to eat/dine at. I decided to give this place a try and went there with my husband and my mother in law. The food turned out to be tasty and not bad for the price as well.

The restaurant has a nice ambience, very airy (because we were sitting at the outdoor sitting area) and clean. The staff were pretty helpful, quick and attentive. Which is quite rare in Hanoi to be honest. 

Food:
Grilled chicken with beer: I have had not seen such tiny and skinny chicken in my entire life (it was so small) - However, it was surprisingly tender and tasty.
Minced beef porridge: Smell super great, tasty and after taste sweetness.

Lotus shoot salad with shrimp and pork belly: this is a standard starter dish as a starter, but it arrived after we had done with our main course, which is super weird.

Deep fried tofu with salted egg: Surprisingly good, really soft and the salted eggs gave the creamy and thick taste - However abit too oily.

Fried Kangkong (Water spinach) : My most favourite dish of all, it tasted so good that I was amazed with such simple dish can bring so much happiness. It was crunchy, greeny, flavourful and the deep fried garlic together with fresh garlic, it just simply tasty.

Price:
Affordable
Reasonable

Overall the experience was good, the food is tasty and I would definitely want to come back here again. Would recommend this place for a family gathering or a small event.
